name: Ray Template Traversal
definition: An approach by Yagel [Yagel-1992-DRT] that stores traversal steps through the volume as a ray template to accelerate rendering for parallel rays (orthographic projection).
summary: Ray Template Traversal accelerates parallel volume rendering by reusing a precomputed 26-connected voxel path, ensuring each voxel is visited exactly once from a base plane before resampling to the screen.
